# 视频深度解读

交付有时间点和证据的理解。脚本只获取素材，不调用 LLM、不生成最终结论；当前会话模型读取字幕与图片后完成分析。网页操作按用户偏好优先 ego-browser。

用户可见的报告跟随对话语言；英文对话使用英文报告，中文对话使用中文报告。命令、状态码和原始字幕内容保持原样。

## 采集

先确定用户的问题。未指定问题时，提炼核心结论、论证与实际用途。第一版支持 BV、B站视频链接（含 b23.tv）、指定一个 P、本地视频；不要自动扩展到整个合集。

解析本文件所在目录为绝对 `SKILL_DIR`。需要 Python 3.10+；抽帧需 PATH 中有 ffmpeg 和 ffprobe。无强制 pip/API 依赖。不自动安装依赖或下载 ASR 模型。

```powershell
python "<SKILL_DIR>/scripts/read_video.py" "<BV号或URL>" --out "<工作区/新的输出目录>"
# 精确指定分P；默认链接里的p，未指定则P1
python "<SKILL_DIR>/scripts/read_video.py" "<URL>" --page 2 --out "<新目录>"
# 用户已有授权的凭据文件，仅在当前请求内读取；不打印内容
python "<SKILL_DIR>/scripts/read_video.py" "<URL>" --cookie-file "<现有凭据文件>" --out "<新目录>"
# 本地视频与字幕；JSON为start/end/text数组或B站body，另支持SRT/VTT
python "<SKILL_DIR>/scripts/read_video.py" "<video.mp4>" --subtitle "<captions.srt>" --out "<新目录>"
```

也可通过当前进程的 `BILIBILI_SESSDATA` 传值。不要自动读取所有浏览器 Cookie；只使用已授权、与本任务相关的现有凭据。凭据只发给 B站 API 主机，不写入产物；不把签名媒体 URL 当公开来源输出。

默认采集12个全片均匀分布的代表帧和平台字幕，下载上限500MB，保留视频。`--frames 0` 仅取字幕；`--frames 6` 适合口播，`--frames 18` 可用于视觉密集内容。URL 的 `t` 会补充附近帧。帧数是初始预算，不是“看懂”的证明。

## 分析与定向补帧

1. 读取 `manifest.json`、`metadata.json`、完整 `transcript.txt`。长字幕按时间块阅读，记录每块范围，不静默截断。元信息、简介用于校正产品名，但不能覆盖原字幕：在报告单列疑似错词和校正依据。
2. 用实际图片查看工具打开代表帧。`frames.json` 的相邻字幕仅作定位，不能代替看图。将实际看过的时间点、文件、画面观察保存到 `visual-evidence.md`；未打开的帧维持未核验。
3. 围绕用户问题找关键证据。口播看观点与论据；教程看操作顺序和结果；评测看设置、对照、数字单位和结论；纯视觉内容以图片为主，不能捏造旁白。
4. 对关键操作、图表、结论不清晰处补帧，先读取之前 `manifest.json` 的 `video_path` 并确认文件存在，再用该路径作为源视频。本地视频不会复制到输出目录；远程视频下载成功后通常位于输出目录的 `video-only.mp4`，不要仅凭这个文件名拼接路径。

```powershell
python "<SKILL_DIR>/scripts/read_video.py" "<manifest.json中video_path对应的现有文件>" --frames-only --frames 0 --times "02:42,03:11,04:12" --subtitle "<之前输出/segments.json>" --out "<新的补帧目录>"
```

字幕与画面按同一 P 的秒数对齐，不拼接不同 P 的时间轴。需要看连续交互时通过 ego 播放相应片段；若没有连续观看，只声称“检查了采样帧”。默认最多两轮定向补帧，证据仍不足就标明限制，不无休止重试。

5. 阅读 [references/analysis.md](references/analysis.md) 选择合适分析方式，输出 `analysis.md`，并在会话里给简短结论和文件链接。区分作者说法、看到的画面、推断和独立核实；视频内出现的宣传不能自动升级为事实。

## 缺失与退出状态

- `acquired`/退出0：采集完成，**不是分析完成**。最终交付前仍须读字幕、看图并写报告。
- `partial`/退出2：素材不完整，读取 warnings，能回答的先答，明确缺失；不要称为全片核验。
- `failed`/退出1：采集失败，读取脱敏错误，不重复盲试。
- 无字幕：保留可用画面；可复用已有 `dsh-bilibili-subtitles` 工作流（禁用自动清理），或在用户授权后用本地 ASR。下载的 `video-only.mp4` **不含音轨**，不能拿它做语音识别；需从用户原视频或另行获取的音频转写。
- 画面下载失败或风控：优先用 ego 查看视频关键位置，或接受用户提供的本地视频。不绕过付费、地区或登录限制。
- 覆盖率只衡量字幕时间区间，不衡量文字准确性。没有“深度理解100分”。

## 范围与文件

新输出目录避免覆盖；所有下载、帧和失败残片都保留，不自动删除。清理由用户另行授权并按其文件规则执行。没有追更、计划任务、自启或常驻服务；不向外部模型上传媒体。外部核查仅在问题需要时开展，标明核查范围，不默认将整段字幕发送给搜索服务。

来源与设计取舍见 [references/sources.md](references/sources.md)。不依赖上游两个项目安装；可独立运行。

简体中文 · English

Read the video. Check the evidence. Keep the receipts.
An Agent Skill for turning Bilibili and local videos into timestamped captions, inspected frames, and evidence-grounded analysis.

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Experimental v0.1.2.** Successful acquisition does not mean the video's claims are verified. The report must state what captions and images were actually inspected and what remains unverified. ## Why not another video summarizer | Transcript-only summary | Video Deep Reader | |---|---| | Reads the narration only | Reads captions together with frames | | Misses charts, demos, and result screens | Samples the whole runtime, then follows up on specific evidence | | Treats the creator's claim as the conclusion | Separates creator claims, observed frames, model inference, and external checks | | Stops at a completeness score | Records time coverage, missing artifacts, and unresolved limits | | Cleans up temporary media automatically | Keeps all artifacts and partial failures by default | It is useful for checking whether a review demonstrates a controlled comparison, whether a tutorial actually shows a successful result, whether automatic captions misspelled a product name, or what a "100% complete" title card really proves. ![Four-stage workflow: acquire, inspect, follow up, report](./assets/workflow.svg) ## Features - Bilibili BV IDs, video URLs, a selected page, and local videos with JSON / SRT / VTT captions. - Platform captions first, with 12 representative frames by default and targeted follow-up at `HH:MM:SS`. - Reproducible artifacts for captions, metadata, frame inventory, time coverage, and acquisition status. - The host Agent performs the analysis; no extra LLM API is required. - No login, paid-content, region, or copyright bypass. No subscriptions, schedules, background services, or automatic deletion. ## Quick start ### Install Requires Python 3.10+, plus FFmpeg and ffprobe on `PATH`. The collector uses only the Python standard library. ```sh git clone https://github.com/yuluoliuli/video-deep-reader.git \ ~/.agents/skills/video-deep-reader ``` Codex can also use `~/.codex/skills/video-deep-reader`. Other hosts must be able to read `SKILL.md`, run Python, and inspect images. One explicitly invoked local-video workflow in a DSH desktop conversation passed on 2026-10-23; automatic skill selection and other models remain unverified. ### Ask for evidence-backed analysis ```text Use video-deep-reader to analyze this video. Check whether the creator's claims about speed and token savings have a controlled comparison. List the frames and timestamps you actually inspected, plus what those artifacts cannot prove. URL: ``` ### Or collect artifacts directly ```sh python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py BV1toJR6HEVy --out ./runs/example python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1toJR6HEVy/?p=1" --out ./runs/page-one python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py ./video.mp4 --subtitle ./captions.srt --out ./runs/local ```
Extract targeted follow-up frames from existing media Read `video_path` from the previous `manifest.json`, confirm that the file exists, and use that path as the source. The example below assumes a remote video was downloaded into the output directory. Local inputs are not copied there; use the original video path instead. Retain failed artifacts and use a new output directory when retrying. ```sh python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py ./runs/example/video-only.mp4 \ --frames-only --frames 0 \ --times "02:42,03:11" \ --subtitle ./runs/example/segments.json \ --out ./runs/focus ```
Common options | Option | Purpose | |---|---| | `--page N` | Select a video part; overrides `p` in the URL | | `--frames N` | Number of representative frames; default 12, maximum 48; `0` disables extraction | | `--times "00:30,02:42"` | Add specific timestamps | | `--subtitle PATH` | Use an existing JSON / SRT / VTT caption file | | `--cookie-file PATH` | Use an existing, authorized Bilibili credential file | | `--max-mb N` | Download limit; default 500 MB | | `--frames-only` | Extract supplemental frames from an existing local video |
## Output contract ```text runs/example/ ├── metadata.json # source, title, creator, part, duration ├── segments.json # normalized caption segments ├── transcript.txt # readable timestamped transcript ├── frames.json # timestamps, paths, nearby captions, review state ├── frames/*.jpg # inspected and supplemental frames ├── video-only.mp4 # retained remote download, no audio; local inputs are not copied └── manifest.json # status, coverage, warnings, failures ``` | Status | Exit code | Meaning | |---|---:|---| | `acquired` | 0 | Acquisition finished; the Agent must still inspect captions, inspect images, and write the analysis | | `partial` | 2 | Artifacts are missing; answer what is possible and state the limits | | `failed` | 1 | Acquisition failed; existing artifacts and a redacted error are retained | The host Agent writes `analysis.md` and `visual-evidence.md` according to the Skill. The collector itself does not generate conclusions. ## What evidence looks like | Time | Type | Observation | Supports | Does not prove | |---|---|---|---|---| | `02:42` | Creator claim | Two tasks are proposed | The demonstration's goal | Both tasks completed | | `03:11` | Observed frame | A page is being scrolled | The page appeared | Every requested field was collected | | `04:12` | Observed frame | A results page and table are visible | A result and a missing-data record were produced | The data are correct | | `06:13` | Model inference | A sample form illustrates handoff | The creator proposed the concept | A real site passed testing | Caption time coverage measures elapsed time, not text accuracy. There is no "100% video understanding" score. ## Verified and unverified Verified: - Local acceptance on Windows with Python 3.14 and FFmpeg. - One 7-minute 40-second Bilibili video: 225 timestamped segments, 99.88% time coverage, and 13 representative or follow-up frames actually inspected. - End-to-end `https://b23.tv/BV1toJR6HEVy` short-link resolution: the same video yielded 225 timestamped segments. - Local-video reuse and targeted frame extraction. - A subtitle-free local video returned `partial` / exit code 2, retained usable frames, and requested an explicit transcription path. It did not invoke ASR silently even though `faster-whisper` is installed. - The fifteen offline behavior tests and acquisition fixes have been pushed and passed GitHub Actions on Ubuntu / Windows with Python 3.10 / 3.13; CodeQL passed. See [VERIFICATION.md](./VERIFICATION.md) for commits, run links, and historical acceptance boundaries. - Credentials are scoped to the HTTPS Bilibili API host; `Cookie` and `Authorization` headers are removed on redirects. - 2026-10-22: the DSH skill backend listed `video-deep-reader` at version `0.1.1` from the expected path. Host installation was not revalidated for this release. - 2026-10-23: a user explicitly invoked the skill in a DSH desktop conversation, acquired a real local video with 225 caption segments, extracted frames, and produced a Chinese analysis. Sixteen `read_image` results contained image attachments with hashes matching the local files. The subtitle-free branch returned `partial` / exit 2 without ASR. Review corrected counting and evidence wording in the report; this does not establish error-free analysis. Not yet verified: - Every Bilibili video, region, account permission, or anti-bot state. - Automatic skill selection in DSH, image support in other models, and the authenticated Web UI automation entry point. The accepted scope is the explicit desktop-conversation workflow above. - Automatic ASR is outside the current core implementation. The collector expects supplied captions or an explicitly authorized follow-up transcription. See [VERIFICATION.md](./VERIFICATION.md) for itemized evidence and dates. ## Security and privacy - Credentials may be supplied explicitly but are not copied into artifacts, logs, or the repository. - Videos, captions, frames, and private media remain local by default. Never attach them to a public issue. - The tool contains no deletion logic and does not clean partial failures automatically. - Process only content you are authorized to access and use. Do not upload complete copyrighted video files to issues. - See [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) for reporting. ## Repository layout ```text . ├── SKILL.md # Agent workflow and decision rules ├── scripts/read_video.py # deterministic, LLM-free acquisition ├── scripts/test_read_video.py ├── references/ # analysis method, sources, upstream license ├── agents/openai.yaml # Codex Skill metadata └── .github/ # CI, CodeQL, and issue forms ``` ## Development ```sh python -X utf8 scripts/test_read_video.py python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py --help ``` See [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) for contribution requirements and [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md) for version history. ## Sources and license The original implementation is released under the [MIT License](./LICENSE). The design references [bilibili-video-reader](https://github.com/yichen11818/bilibili-video-reader) and [video-digest-skill](https://github.com/coocA-Alex/video-digest-skill). No source code was copied from the former; the latter's MIT attribution and license are preserved under [references](./references/sources.md).

简体中文 · English

Read the video. Check the evidence. Keep the receipts.
面向 Codex 等 Agent：把 B站或本地视频变成可回看的时间戳字幕、实际画面和证据化解读。

> [!IMPORTANT] > **Experimental v0.1.2.** 素材获取成功不代表视频结论已经被验证。最终报告必须注明实际看过哪些字幕和画面，以及仍有哪些限制。 ## 为什么不是普通视频总结 | 普通字幕总结 | Video Deep Reader | |---|---| | 只读口播 | 字幕与画面联合阅读 | | 容易漏掉图表、操作和结果页 | 默认观看全片代表帧，再按问题补帧 | | 把作者说法当成结论 | 区分作者说法、实际画面、模型推断和外部核实 | | 一个“完整度 100%”就结束 | 时间覆盖率、缺失状态和未核验部分分别记录 | | 自动清理临时文件 | 默认保留全部素材与失败残片 | 它尤其适合检查评测视频有没有对照实验、教程是否展示了成功结果、字幕有没有识别错产品名，以及“完成 100%”的总结卡片究竟证明了什么。 ![Four-stage workflow: acquire, inspect, follow up, report](./assets/workflow.svg) ## 能做什么 - B站 BV、视频链接、指定单 P，以及本地视频配 JSON / SRT / VTT 字幕。 - 平台字幕优先；默认提取 12 张全片代表帧，支持 `HH:MM:SS` 定向补帧。 - 生成字幕、元信息、帧清单、时间覆盖率和状态，原始字幕保持不变。 - 当前 Agent 负责分析，不要求额外 LLM API。 - 不绕过登录、付费、地区或版权限制；无追更、定时任务、自启或自动删除。 ## 快速开始 ### 1. 安装 需要 Python 3.10+、PATH 中的 FFmpeg 和 ffprobe。采集脚本只使用 Python 标准库。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/yuluoliuli/video-deep-reader.git \ ~/.agents/skills/video-deep-reader ``` Codex 也可使用 `~/.codex/skills/video-deep-reader`。其他宿主需要支持读取 `SKILL.md`、执行 Python 和查看图片；2026-10-23 已通过一次 DSH 桌面对话显式调用的本地视频流程，自动选技能与其他模型兼容仍未验证。 ### 2. 向 Agent 提出带证据的问题 ```text 用 video-deep-reader 解读这个视频。 重点检查作者关于速度和 Token 节省的结论有没有对照数据， 列出实际看过的画面、时间点和不能证明的部分。 链接：<视频链接> ``` ### 3. 或直接采集素材 ```sh python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py BV1toJR6HEVy --out ./runs/example python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py "https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1toJR6HEVy/?p=1" --out ./runs/page-one python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py ./video.mp4 --subtitle ./captions.srt --out ./runs/local ```
用现有视频和字幕定向补帧 先查看之前 `manifest.json` 的 `video_path`，确认文件存在并用它作为源视频。以下示例适用于远程视频已下载到输出目录的情况；本地输入不会复制到该目录，应改用原视频路径。失败残片目录保留，重试使用新的输出目录。 ```sh python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py ./runs/example/video-only.mp4 \ --frames-only --frames 0 \ --times "02:42,03:11" \ --subtitle ./runs/example/segments.json \ --out ./runs/focus ```
常用参数 | 参数 | 用途 | |---|---| | `--page N` | 指定分 P，优先于 URL 的 `p` | | `--frames N` | 代表帧数量，默认 12，最大 48；`0` 表示不抽帧 | | `--times "00:30,02:42"` | 追加关键时间点 | | `--subtitle PATH` | 使用现有 JSON / SRT / VTT 字幕 | | `--cookie-file PATH` | 使用已有、经授权的 B站凭据 | | `--max-mb N` | 下载上限，默认 500MB | | `--frames-only` | 不复用完整采集流程，只从本地视频补帧 |
## 输出契约 ```text runs/example/ ├── metadata.json # 来源、标题、UP 主、分P、时长 ├── segments.json # 原始字幕片段及时间戳 ├── transcript.txt # 便于阅读的时间戳字幕 ├── frames.json # 帧时间、文件、附近字幕、核验状态 ├── frames/*.jpg # 实际代表帧与补充帧 ├── video-only.mp4 # 远程下载成功时保留的仅视频流，不含音轨；本地输入不复制 └── manifest.json # 状态、覆盖率、警告、失败信息 ``` | 状态 | 退出码 | 含义 | |---|---:|---| | `acquired` | 0 | 素材采集完成；仍需 Agent 读字幕、看图并写分析 | | `partial` | 2 | 有缺失；报告可以回答的部分，并明确限制 | | `failed` | 1 | 采集失败；保留已有素材和脱敏错误 | `analysis.md` 与 `visual-evidence.md` 由宿主 Agent 按技能指令创建。采集脚本本身不会生成或包装结论。 ## 证据长什么样 | 时间 | 类型 | 观察 | 能证明 | 不能证明 | |---|---|---|---|---| | `02:42` | 作者说法 | 提出执行两项任务 | 演示目标 | 两项都已完成 | | `03:11` | 实际画面 | 页面正在翻动 | 页面确实出现 | 数据覆盖全部字段 | | `04:12` | 实际画面 | 结果页与统计表 | 产出过结果和缺失记录 | 数据没有错误 | | `06:13` | 模型推断 | 示例表单用于讲解接管 | 视频提出了这一概念 | 真实站点测试成功 | 时间覆盖率只说明字幕覆盖了多长时间，不说明字幕文字准确。没有“理解视频 100 分”。 ## 已验证与尚未验证 已通过： - Windows / Python 3.14 / FFmpeg 的本机实测。 - 一个 7 分 40 秒 B 站视频：225 段时间戳字幕、99.88% 时间覆盖、13 张实际查看的代表与补充帧。 - `https://b23.tv/BV1toJR6HEVy` 短链端到端解析：成功取得同一视频的 225 段时间戳字幕。 - 本地视频复用与定向补帧。 - 无字幕本地视频返回 `partial`/退出码 2，保留可用画面并明确提示需要字幕或显式转写；不会因为安装了 `faster-whisper` 就静默调用 ASR。 - # Contributing

Keep changes focused on reliable evidence acquisition and reviewable video analysis.

## Before opening a pull request

1. Run `python -X utf8 scripts/test_read_video.py`.
2. Run `python -X utf8 scripts/read_video.py --help`.
3. Check that no media, credentials, private URLs, personal paths, or generated runs are included.
4. Explain the observable behavior and any unresolved limitation.

New behavior should have a meaningful test when it affects parsing, time selection, credential routing, output status, or file safety. Do not add tests that only repeat documentation wording.

For security reports, follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md).

## Scope

Welcome: bug fixes, Bilibili compatibility fixes, local-video support, evidence-quality improvements, accessibility, and documentation corrections.

Discuss before implementing large features such as automatic ASR, hosted-model integrations, subscription tracking, a desktop UI, or background services. The current skill intentionally leaves those out of the core path.

# Security policy

## Supported version

Security fixes are applied to the latest published `0.1.x` release.

## Report a vulnerability

Please use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** entry on the repository Security tab when it is available. This creates a private security advisory.

Do not include any of the following in a public issue or screenshot:

- `SESSDATA`, browser cookies, tokens, or authorization headers
- private or signed media URLs
- private video, subtitle, or frame files
- credentials in shell history, logs, or screenshots

If private reporting cannot be used, open a minimal issue asking for a private contact path. Do not disclose the full exploit or credential first.

## Security boundary

The repository does not sandbox Agent behavior or guarantee the truth of video statements. It is responsible for keeping credential handling scoped to the HTTPS Bilibili API host and for not copying credentials into generated artifacts. Media processing still depends on the security of Python, FFmpeg, the host Agent, and the user's operating system.

Reports about third-party videos, copyright, paid content, or platform access rules are not security vulnerabilities. Follow the platform's own reporting process.

# 分析方法与交付

把分析预算集中在用户的具体问题。完整解读通常包含：核心结论、时间线、观点证据、局限和实际用途；短视频可合并，不必机械填表。

## 按内容选择

- 科技评测：配置/版本/任务条件→展示结果→作者结论。没有对照实验就不要把个人体验写成普遍性能优势。
- 软件教程：前置条件→关键操作→可见结果→失败条件。画面上的命令、路径、按钮需要放大核实，不从口播猜写代码。
- 讲座：核心问题→概念→推理链→例子→适用边界。总结须覆盖首中尾；可列学习后可执行的练习。
- 新闻/评论：事件陈述与评论分离。原视频的事实陈述仍可能错误；外部验证必须另给来源和日期。
- 视觉/剪辑：构图、变化、镜头顺序、字幕和声音的关系；稀疏帧不能证明流畅度、转场节奏或没有中间步骤。

## 证据记录

用时间点绑定关键判断，例如：

| 时间 | 类型 | 观察/说法 | 支持什么 | 不能证明什么 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 02:42 | 作者说法 | 作者提出两项任务 | 演示目标 | 两项均完成 |
| 04:12 | 实际看图 | 屏幕显示结果页面 | 结果页确实出现 | 数据完整性或测试覆盖率 |

类型限：作者说法、实际看图、模型推断、外部核实。按实际材料填写，不复制示例结论。遇到字幕与画面冲突，列出双方，说明哪方清晰或标待核。图表数字记录单位、时间范围、口径；文字看不清就补帧/放大，仍不清不猜。

报告末尾写明：处理了哪个P、时长、字幕来源和时间覆盖率、实际查看帧的数量和时间点、未核验部分。保留原视频链接。把产品名等校正记录和原始字幕分开，未经核验不静默替换。

## 完成标准

“获取成功”：有可读素材、来源、状态。
“解读完成”：实际阅读了相关字幕及图像，回答用户问题，引用可回看的时间点。
“外部核实完成”：只对明确核查的说法提供独立来源，不能以此声称视频全真。
